reason: A visual theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web interface that changes colors, title fonts, and limited styling without changing page structure; it also serves locally installed fonts through a read-only route.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供神里绫华主题风格的配色、标题字体和视觉样式定制。
summaries.en: Provides a Kamisato Ayaka-inspired visual theme for the DeepSeek Harness web interface with custom colors, title fonts, and limited styling.

capabilities: Applies custom colors, fonts, and visual styles to the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Serves locally installed font files through a read-only host route
